about: Allies: other minds in metal the signal can link with. One joins each host (two with Second link). Each unlocks the first time any host clears its level. Stats are relative to a regular enemy of that level; moves never change. Allies gain levels across hosts (+8% a level, up to 10).

allies.name: Bale
allies.blurb: A dock-loader frame. Whoever was copied into it still says sorry when it bumps into things.

moves.name: Shoulder Check
moves.description: A heavy shove at close range

moves.name: Draw Fire
moves.description: Every enemy aims at Bale until your next turn. Bale guards +10

allies.name: Matron
allies.blurb: A private-ward nurse unit. She was a real nurse once. She doesn't talk about which one.

moves.name: Field Mend
moves.description: Heals you for 25% of your max health, from anywhere

allies.name: Ghostline
allies.blurb: A military sensor shell. Its mind was a soldier's, sold in a lot of forty.

moves.name: Signal Bleed
moves.description: A ranged hit that cooks circuits

moves.name: Paint Target
moves.description: Your hits on the target do 35% more until your next turn. Any range

allies.name: Ward
allies.blurb: A Helix continuity guard that walked off its post. Still won't carry a gun.

moves.name: Aegis Field
moves.description: You guard +14 against the next hit, from anywhere

allies.name: Breaker
allies.blurb: Operator limbs on a cheap torso. The mind inside asks for one thing: something to hit.

moves.name: Breach
moves.description: A charging blow. Needs a run-up
